FILES: `rich/markdown.py` (Markdown.__rich_console__)

CAUSE: The `Markdown` class currently ignores leading and trailing newlines because it only processes tokens generated by the markdown parser (likely `markdown-it-py`), which trims or handles block-level spacing in a way that doesn't automatically translate to `rich` newlines at the boundaries of the document. REPRO: The reproduction script shows that `Markdown("\n\nHello\n\nWorld\n\n")` does not preserve the leading and trailing newlines in the output.
